topLevel.why: The two trees match at every boundary up to block 884. X then starts a separate back-matter part at Acknowledgements (block 963). Y runs Historic Perspective on through the Acknowledgements and only breaks at the Bibliography.

gists.why: For passages 3 and 4, X places each in its own subsection (Isometries; Tangent bundles and the Structure group) with a gist that fits the passage. Y gives only broad chapter-level gists there. Elsewhere the two are close, with Y slightly more specific on passage 6.

weldedParts.why: It absorbs the Acknowledgements (blocks 963-965), which are back matter separate from Chapter 7, into the historical chapter.

overall.why: X keeps the Acknowledgements out of Chapter 7, and its gists for the deeper subsections are more precise. Otherwise the two trees are nearly identical.
